name: CardChoiceList - SeveralTaken
description: Two options taken out of four. The change the whole list turns on: options used to SUBMIT on click, so a shortlist allowed exactly one answer — and two of those is an ordinary thing to want to say. A taken option is filled rather than merely tinted, because these pills sit on a card already saturated in its theme hue and a fill is the only difference that survives that ground.
